title: Overriding Dependencies for Tests
description: Replace dependencies with mocks to isolate the code under test.

slides.title: Dependency Override 🎭
slides.content:
# Isolate Your Tests

FastAPI allows you to override dependencies during testing. This is perfect for replacing real database sessions or authentication with mock versions.

Use `app.dependency_overrides`.

slides.title: Overriding a Dependency
slides.content:
```python
from main import app, get_db

async def override_get_db():
    # Return a mock database session
    return MockSession()

app.dependency_overrides[get_db] = override_get_db

# Now, any test that uses get_db will get the mock.
```

quizData.question: What is the purpose of `app.dependency_overrides`?

options.text: It disables all dependencies during tests
It allows you to replace a dependency with a test version

quizData.explanation: `dependency_overrides` is a dictionary mapping original dependencies to test doubles, enabling isolated testing.
